responsibility: Declares the trait-resolution entry points for the Rust typechecker. ResolveTraitItemToRef builds TraitItemReference objects from HIR trait items, while TraitResolver exposes resolution and lookup of trait type paths or trait items into the cached TraitReference representation used by bound checking, path probing, and impl validation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the trait-resolution front end, namely ResolveTraitItemToRef and TraitResolver entry points for turning HIR trait items or type paths into TraitReference objects. Unlike rust-hir-trait-resolve.cc, it specifies the resolver interfaces without implementing path lookup, caching, or trait construction.
